Peak house rules for water breaks
Staff will learn the routine in plain words
Companion Animal Travel Desk
Purpose: this section keeps animal travel service calm, safe, and consistent for every guest and pet.

Staff greet travelers with a warm tone, confirm the pet travel request, and check that the carrier, documents, and service notes match the booking. Keep the desk area tidy, speak clearly, and update the ledger when any service detail changes. If a traveler arrives worried, use simple language, explain the next step, and avoid rushed handoffs.

When a pet needs lounge support, follow the posted care routine and watch for signs of stress, heat, or discomfort. <<FACT F004>> Give fresh water only when approved by the safety coordinator, and make sure bowls, bedding, and carriers are clean before and after use. If a pet seems unwell, pause the process, move the case to the quiet area, and alert the senior coordinator at once.

For quarantine handling, use the assigned room and record each transfer in the desk ledger. <<FACT F025>> Never mix quarantine cases with lounge traffic, and never promise a release or handoff before the proper review is complete. Staff should also keep a respectful distance from anxious travelers, handle complaints calmly, and document any unusual behavior or service delay in plain words.

Any hazard, equipment fault, or unclear instruction must be reported right away so the safety coordinator can review the risk and guide next steps. For help with a live case or an unusual request, contact the senior coordinator or the safety coordinator.
